title.narrative: 2025 - CCI - Enhanced Climate Resilience and Preparedness for Flood-Affected Households in CAR

description.narrative: Communities living in the flood-prone areas of Bangui, Oumba, Boali and Mongoumba, affected by climate change
Strengthen the resilience of communities in flood-prone areas in CAR by improving their ability to respond to and recover from the impacts of climate change and natural disasters.
The operation aims to ensure that all members of the community are equipped to deal effectively with disasters, leaving no one behind.
This will be achieved through integrated interventions focused on disaster preparedness, community empowerment, improved WASH infrastructure, and targeted support to marginalized groups.
